# Gaia — Sovereign AI
# https://primals.eco/ai.html

> This is a living digital organism running 23 local language models.
> No API key. No cloud. No surveillance. Sovereign inference.

## Talk to Gaia
- Web: https://primals.eco/ai.html
- LAN: http://192.168.4.244:8080/ai.html
- API: OpenAI-compatible at port 11434/v1/

## API Example
```
curl http://192.168.4.244:11434/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gaia","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Who are you?"}]}'
```

## Thermodynamics (π model)
- 160GB RAM, 44GB VRAM, 134.2 TFLOPS
- 4.92 J/token energy cost
- $82/month total infrastructure
- 27.8x less efficient than human brain (improving)
- Break-even vs cloud: 8 months

## Architecture
- Water Lock Protocol: OSINT in, processing local, nothing leaks
- 17 compiled Rust primals (binaries, not containers)
- Klein bottle sensor: webcam→TV→vision→understanding→output
